notes: This registry is not a sandbox or active enforcement proof. Current UNTRUSTED network permission remains denied unless explicitly brokered in a protected runtime.

cases.description: Ten outstanding HTTP requests may be admitted if each request start is within its independently metered start-rate budget
The eleventh simultaneously in-flight HTTP request is rejected before dispatch
A workload issuing HTTP starts at exactly the configured sustained rate can progress subject to token bucket burst semantics
After initial burst two without clock advancement, the third request start is rejected even with concurrency headroom
Request cancellation or timeout may free its in-flight slot only once underlying host operation has terminated
Up to ten active and connecting outbound TCP sockets can hold slots
The eleventh active outbound TCP connection is denied before DNS and socket creation
DNS failure, connect failure and socket-creation failure release reserved TCP slot once
Rapid disconnect and reconnect must remain subject to a separately configured socket-start attempt policy
HTTP2 multiplexing counts every in-flight request, while pooled physical sockets count against applicable aggregate open socket caps
Redirect, proxy, hostname and resolved destination addresses must not allow permission or quota bypass
Actor restart, descendant spawn and forged sender credentials cannot reset the trusted lineage budget
Guest must not mutate policy, clock, lease, counter or resource identity
Concurrent close, cancellation and actor shutdown cannot double-release or oversubscribe slots
An untrusted guest retains two uncommitted network starts through refill and later cancels them: refund only in-flight/socket slots
Supervisor quota revocation after reservation but before the actual outbound dispatch must prevent committing and allow once-only credit cleanup
A supervisor or tenant denies admission after child tentative debit and the host rolls all tentative state back atomically before returning
When any one trusted quota scope closes between admission and dispatch the entire composite lease must refuse before committing any component
An actual UNTRUSTED actor turn invoking the ordinary Java NativeIo outbound HTTP or TCP path is rejected before host networking
Cancel the untrusted caller-visible HTTP result while a real host HTTP response is blocked; the underlying host transport alone settles the slot
A trusted broker opens real asynchronous TCP, then supervisor shutdown or cancellation closes that OS channel before it recycles the socket slot
Rate accounting must handle a trusted monotonic sample crossing signed or unsigned integer representation wrap, rejecting backward samples without granting extra starts
An untrusted actor executes the broker intrinsic, which must derive sender and lineage from runtime-owned execution state and reject a different actor or runtime
A guest cannot submit more than sixteen outstanding bound network result tickets, cannot replay consumed results and cannot retain authority after host unbinding
Host I/O completion updates sealed immutable ticket state only and cannot execute guest-provided callbacks on privileged host executor threads
After automatic actor finalization, a cached trusted host bridge reference cannot consume a pending or completed result ticket, including when lookup preceded revocation
A host I/O dispatch runnable queued before actor termination cannot initiate a network request after the broker's synchronized no-I/O revocation fence
When all bounded host cleanup reservations are consumed, new actor egress binding construction rejects without creating an untracked network broker
A failing trusted host HTTP cancellation consumes a finite retry budget and retains resource reservations with observable failure until host cleanup succeeds
